drawio.description: Official draw.io MCP (jgraph) — supports Mermaid, XML, CSV input. Generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and block diagrams that open directly in Draw.io editor.

visio.description: Microsoft Visio .vsdx generation — professional flowchart, block diagram, and interface diagram creation for user manuals and formal documentation

math.description: Engineering calculator — Python math expressions, unit conversion (Pint), date/calendar. For MCU datasheet: SNR, power budget, thermal, timing, baud rate error.
